# Contributing

The projects of the `xwiki-contrib` organization are developed by the [XWiki Contrib](https://contrib.xwiki.org) community, not by the XWiki core development team.

* [Contributing to an existing project](https://contrib.xwiki.org/xwiki/bin/view/Main/WebHome#HContributingtoanexistingproject): introduce yourself on the [forum](https://forum.xwiki.org/c/Dev) to get access to a project.
* [Requesting a project](https://contrib.xwiki.org/xwiki/bin/view/Main/WebHome#HRequestingaproject): how to get a new repository in this organization.
* [Development practices](https://dev.xwiki.org/xwiki/bin/view/Community/DevelopmentPractices): contrib projects follow the same rules as XWiki itself (issues, commits, pull requests).
* [Security policy](https://dev.xwiki.org/xwiki/bin/view/Community/SecurityPolicy/): how to report a vulnerability. Never report one in a public issue or pull request.

GitHub Issues are disabled on contrib repositories: each project's issue tracker is linked from its `README.md`.
